title: Dota 2 Roles & Lane Economy Guide (Pos 1 to Pos 5)
content:
Dota 2 Roles, Farm Priority & Lane Economy Guide:

• Position 1 (Safelane Carry):
Highest farm priority on the team. Plays in the safe lane (Radiant Bottom / Dire Top) with the hard support. Early game goal is secure last hitting, lane equilibrium, and trading regen (Tango, Quelling Blade, Iron Branch, Circlet/Wraith Band/Bracer). Needs farm accelerators (Battle Fury, Maelstrom, Mask of Madness, Radiance) and mid-game survivability (BKB, Manta Style, Sange and Yasha). Scales into physical late-game monsters (Daedalus, Butterfly, Eye of Skadi, Satanic, Nullifier).
NOTE ON BOTTLE: Safelane carries NEVER buy Bottle. The safelane has no access to water runes or power runes; carries sustain using Tangos, courier regen consumables, and lifesteal.

• Position 2 (Mid Lane):
Solo lane with equal 1v1 matchup and solo XP/Gold priority. Centered around wave manipulation and rune control.
NOTE ON BOTTLE: Mid heroes almost always buy Bottle because of proximity to Water Runes (spawning at 2:00 and 4:00) and Power Runes (spawning every 2 minutes starting at 6:00). Bottle allows mid laners to aggressively trade and spam spells to clear waves and secure runes. Mid laners hit early level 6/12/18 power spikes and dictate the mid-game tempo.

• Position 3 (Offlane Core):
Plays in the hard lane (Radiant Top / Dire Bottom) against the enemy carry. Primary roles: lane dominance, initiating teamfights, durable frontlining, and aura carrying. Buys early bulk (Bracer, Phase Boots, Vanguard, Blink Dagger). In mid/late game, buys teamfight initiation and protective auras (Pipe of Insight, Crimson Guard, Shiva's Guard, Lotus Orb, BKB, Harpoon).

• Position 4 (Soft Support):
Roaming playmaker and secondary initiator. Contests runes (water runes, power runes, wisdom runes), stacks neutral camps, and ganks mid/safe lanes. Operates on low economy; buys high-impact tactical items (Blink Dagger, Force Staff, Eul's Scepter, Spirit Vessel, Solar Crest, Glimmer Cape).

• Position 5 (Hard Support):
Lowest farm priority. Babysits and secures farm for the Pos 1 safelane carry, controls lane creep equilibrium via pulling, and purchases vision consumables (Observer Wards, Sentry Wards, Smoke of Deceit, Dust of Appearance). Item builds focus entirely on cheap team saves (Force Staff, Glimmer Cape, Pavise, Solar Crest, Ghost Scepter).

title: Laning Dynamics, Runes & Resource Sustain Guide
content:
Laning Dynamics, Runes & Resource Sustain Fundamentals:

• Water Runes (2:00 & 4:00):
Spawn simultaneously at both river power rune locations at 2:00 and 4:00. Instantly restore 40 Health and 20 Mana, and refill a Bottle by 2 charges. They are strictly a mid-lane mechanic to sustain mana and health without returning to base or overloading the courier.

• Power Runes (6:00, 8:00, 10:00+):
Spawn every 2 minutes at ONE random river location starting at minute 6:00. Completely refills Bottle to 3 charges and grants game-changing temporary buffs (Double Damage, Haste, Invisibility, Arcane, Regeneration, Shield). Controls mid-lane gank timings.

• Side-Lane Sustain vs Bottle:
Side lanes (Safelane and Offlane) are too far from river runes. Side-lane cores NEVER buy Bottle because walking to mid runes abandons lane farm and XP. Side-lane sustain relies on:
- Base HP Regen & Consumables: Tangos, Healing Salves, Faerie Fires, Blood Grenades.
- Early Components: Ring of Health (builds into Vanguard or Battle Fury), Headress, Morbid Mask, Bracer.
- Mana Sustain: Magic Stick/Wand, Ring of Basilius, Soul Ring (for Strength casters like Dragon Knight, Mars, Sven), and Clarities.

• Lotus Pools (3:00, 6:00, 9:00+):
Located at the outer side lanes. Spawns Healing Lotuses that combine into Great Lotuses, giving side-laners burst health and mana restore.

• Wisdom Runes (7:00, 14:00, 21:00+):
Located near the team bases. Grants massive team XP, primarily collected by supports to secure level 6 and level 12 ultimate timings.

title: Item Purpose Taxonomy: Farming Accelerators & Jungle Economy
content:
Item Purpose Taxonomy: Farming Accelerators & Economy:

• Mask of Madness (MoM):
Grants +10 Damage, +110 Attack Speed, and +20% Lifesteal during its 6-second Berserk active at the cost of -8 Armor and a 6-second Silence. Cost: 1775 gold.
Strategic Usage: Exceptional cheap farming accelerator for heroes that rely on right-click damage and passive cleave/bonus damage (Sven, Faceless Void inside Chronosphere, Drow Ranger, Sniper, and Carry Magnus using Empower cleave on ancient stacks). Highly flexible because it can be disassembled in the mid/late game: Morbid Mask goes into Satanic, Quarterstaff goes into Butterfly or Bloodthorn.

• Battle Fury:
Grants +65 Damage, +7.5 HP regen, +2.75 Mana regen, and 50% melee Cleave. Cost: 4100 gold.
Strategic Usage: Premier melee farming engine for cores that have innate mobility or critical strike (Anti-Mage, Phantom Assassin, Juggernaut, Faceless Void, Troll Warlord). Provides complete health and mana self-sufficiency for clearing jungle and pushing waves endlessly.

• Maelstrom, Gleipnir & Mjollnir:
Maelstrom (+24 Damage, Chain Lightning on attack) provides cheap magical waveclear. Upgrades into:
- Gleipnir: Eternal Chains AoE root and stats. Essential for tempo ranged carries (Windranger, Mirana, Weaver, Hoodwink) or heroes needing reliable setup.
- Mjollnir: Maximum attack speed (+70) and Static Charge shield. Premier anti-illusion and high-DPS scaling item (Arc Warden, Faceless Void, Juggernaut, Slardar).

• Hand of Midas:
Transmutes non-hero unit for 160 Gold and 2.1x XP (90s cooldown). Bought on heroes that scale disproportionately with levels and talents (Arc Warden, Invoker, Doom) or when playing in passive, greedy game states.

• Radiance:
Grants +55 Damage, 15% evasion, and Burn aura (60 magic DPS + 15% blind in 700 AoE). Core on illusion carries (Naga Siren, Spectre, Phantom Lancer) and tanky frontline attrition cores (Wraith King, Lifestealer, Alchemist, Necrophos, Doom).

title: Item Purpose Taxonomy: Early Combat Spikes & Initiation
content:
Item Purpose Taxonomy: Early Combat Spikes & Initiation Timing Windows:

• Echo Sabre & Harpoon:
- Echo Sabre: Gives +15 Damage, +13 Strength, +10 Attack Speed, +1.75 Mana regen, and double-attack slow. Critical 12-18m timing item for melee brawlers (Sven, Slardar, Tiny, Carry Magnus).
- Harpoon: Combines Echo Sabre with Diadem to grant the Harpoon active (pulls the hero and target enemy toward each other, providing instant gap close and double-attack burst). Crucial gap-closer for immobile melee carries.

• Armlet of Mordiggian:
Unholy Strength toggles +25 Strength, +35 Damage, and +10 Armor at the cost of draining 45 HP/second. King of early-game Strength brawlers (Huskar, Lifestealer, Chaos Knight, Wraith King, Kunkka). Allows elite players to survive lethal damage via 'Armlet toggling'.

• Diffusal Blade & Disperser:
Burns 40 mana per hit and slows on active. Upgrades into Disperser, which grants AoE unslowable haste and target purge. Core on tempo agility carries (Slark, Riki, Phantom Lancer, Ursa).

• Blink Dagger & Tier 5 Upgrades:
Instant 1200-distance teleportation (disabled for 3s upon taking player damage). The single most important initiation item in Dota 2. Core on teamfight initiators (Magnus, Axe, Centaur, Tidehunter, Mars, Slardar, Sand King) and burst cores (Ursa, Sven, Tiny). Late game upgrades:
- Overwhelming Blink: Strength AoE damage, 50% slow, and 50 attack speed slow.
- Swift Blink: Agility burst, +35 Agility and +40% movement speed for 6s.
- Arcane Blink: Lowers cast points and gives spell cooldown reduction.

title: Item Purpose Taxonomy: Defensive Mechanics, Dispels & Magic Immunity
content:
Item Purpose Taxonomy: Dispels, Magic Debuff Immunity & Defensive Items:

• Black King Bar (BKB):
Grants Debuff Immunity and 50% Magic Resistance (duration scales 9s down to 6s). The definitive core item in Dota 2. Prevents enemy magic burst and disables from interrupting core heroes during teamfights.

• Basic Dispels vs Strong Dispels:
- Basic Dispels (Manta Style, Lotus Orb, Eul's Scepter, Guardian Greaves): Removes silences, slows, roots, tracking debuffs, and item burns (e.g. Urn/Vessel). Cannot remove hard stuns, taunts, or banishes.
- Strong Dispels (Aphotic Shield, Press the Attack, False Promise, Dark Pact, Kraken Shell, Satanic Unholy Rage): Removes hard stuns, sleep, and taunts from allies or self.

• Manta Style:
Applies an instant basic dispel, grants temporary invulnerability frames (disjointing projectiles), and creates 2 illusions. Core defensive and offensive farming tool on Agility carries (Anti-Mage, Faceless Void, Phantom Assassin, Terrorblade, Naga Siren, Medusa).

• Linken's Sphere:
Blocks one targeted enemy spell passively every 14 seconds. The premier hard counter to point-target piercing ultimates (Legion Commander Duel, Doom, Bane Fiend's Grip, Beastmaster Primal Roar, Spirit Breaker Charge).

• Lotus Orb:
Applies Echo Shell: casts an instant basic dispel on the target and reflects all single-target enemy spells back at the caster for 6 seconds. Essential on offlaners and utility supports against heavy targeted hex/stuns.

• Aeon Disk:
Triggers when user health drops below 70%: applies a strong dispel and grants 100% damage reduction and 75% status resistance for 2.5 seconds. Mandatory survival item for squishy supports and backline casters against instant burst heroes (Faceless Void, Phantom Assassin, Nyx Assassin).

title: Item Purpose Taxonomy: Hard Disables, Evasion Counters & Decisive Closers
content:
Item Purpose Taxonomy: Hard Disables, Evasion Counters & Late Game Closers:

• Scythe of Vyse (Hex):
Instant 2.8s disable that mutes, silences, and turns the target into a harmless critter with 140 base movement speed. Hex has ZERO projectile travel time, giving targets no time to activate BKB or escape. The premier late-game closing item on Intelligence cores and playmakers.

• Nullifier:
Fires a projectile that continuously dispels the target for 5 seconds and slows them by 80% on every physical attack. The ultimate counter to support defensive items: Nullifier completely dispels Ghost Scepter, Force Staff, Glimmer Cape, Eul's Scepter of Divinity, and Aeon Disk.

• Refresher Orb:
Resets all ability and item cooldowns on a 200s cooldown (costs 350 mana). Game-deciding on heroes with massive teamfight ultimates (Magnus Reverse Polarity, Tidehunter Ravage, Enigma Black Hole, Faceless Void Chronosphere, Doom, Silencer Global Silence).

• Monkey King Bar (MKB) vs Bloodthorn:
- Monkey King Bar: Gives +40 Damage, +35 Attack Speed, and an 80% chance to Pierce through Evasion (true strike) with bonus pure damage. Direct counter to Butterfly, Phantom Assassin Blur, and Windranger Windrun.
- Bloodthorn: Silences target for 5s, amplifying damage taken and giving ALL attackers 100% True Strike against the target with bonus magic burst.

• Eye of Skadi:
Grants +22 to all attributes, +220 HP, +220 Mana. Attacks slow movement and attack speed, and crucially reduce ALL enemy HP regeneration, lifesteal, and healing by 40%. Mandatory counter against heavy regeneration and lifesteal cores (Morphling, Slark, Alchemist, Necrophos, Satanic buyers).
